media.alt_text: Gluten-free baked goods at Comeconoco bakery in Osaka

caption.body:
Comeconoco in Osaka — a dedicated gluten-free bakery specializing in rice flour. Breads, pastries, cakes, all made in a fully GF facility.

Walking into a bakery in Japan and being able to eat everything off the shelf was a first for me. 5/5 on my GF safety scale.
